what_this_change_does: Adds one private bounded integer-phase mono 16k resampler shared by microphone and system-audio Endpoint consumers. Exact 16k passthrough and centered filtered resampling replace float-phase interpolation; normal utterance cuts keep filter state while real finish/gaps flush and clear the continuity run.
review_outcome: No confirmed must-fix found in this frozen source. Suitable for the next separately authorized guarded Rust compile/test phase; not a runtime, DSP-performance, hardware, ASR-quality, package or reference pass.

reviewed_flow.check: Capture callbacks still packetize finite-bounded source-labelled blocks and try_send. The complete callback/capture/Utterance source prefix matches base except the private module declaration. No coefficient setup/filtering was moved into callbacks or drawing.

Separate Endpoints remain owned by the capture consumer. Live pushes and the bounded final drain use the same public push/finish interface; both endpoints finalize after the packet budget, including stop/error paths.

All input length/finite/count checks precede mutation. The output position is integer outputs*rate/16000; phase row 0..63 and next row 1..64 stay inside the 65-row table. Push output positions have their entire nonnegative future support available; only start/finish use zero padding.

output_limit=ceil(available*16000/rate), with available=N-half for ordinary pushes and N for finish. Thus all final positions have j*rate/16000<N. Dropping only indices before floor(next_output*rate/16000)-half preserves the next window. first_input never passes a needed sample and discard never exceeds retained history.

Source/rate/length/value, sequence, packet timestamp, nominal run timeline and output-count overflow checks precede gap finalization or stream mutation. A real gap finishes the old run once, then constructs independent history; an empty gap cannot create a new resampler.

The resampler advances even when the endpoint discards leading quiet output. finish_utterance clears PCM/cadence/identity only, preserving filter and integer run clock across silence/12s cuts. Public finish takes the resampler once, appends its tail, clears run metadata, then finalizes; repeated finish cannot render a second tail.

Output start/end use run origin plus exact 16k grid positions in u128; end is capped by the nominal captured-run end. Prechecks make the final u64 casts safe. Accepted packet jitter and physical clock drift remain the explicitly declared nominal-clock limitation.

bounds_reasoning_source_only.coefficient_table: half=ceil(32*max(rate,16000)/16000)<=384;65*(2*half+1)<=49985 f32 coefficients (199940 payload bytes), excluding allocator overhead and the temporary row.
bounds_reasoning_source_only.lookahead: half/rate<=4ms; identity 16k uses half 0 and returns the original finite f32 bits.
bounds_reasoning_source_only.history: Logical sample history is kept only from the next needed window. The declared PACKET_FRAMES+2*half+ceil(rate/16000)+1 constructor/test envelope is at most 1805 logical entries. Vec capacity/allocator/RSS are not measured by this review.
bounds_reasoning_source_only.per_push_output: At most ceil(1024*16000/rate)<=2048 samples; finish adds at most 64 positions. Integer counters and u128 products cover the validated u64 input/output domain.
bounds_reasoning_source_only.endpoint_pcm: The existing cut remains packet-granular: it is checked after bounded output append, rather than promising a strict 12.000-second maximum. A nonempty active PCM buffer can peak at 192000+2048-1 samples before that cut; ordinary final flush adds only the bounded tail. Queued partials/finals retain the unchanged bounded caller channel.
bounds_reasoning_source_only.timestamp: For output index j, nominal start=origin+floor(j*1e9/16000), with final end capped by origin+floor(N*1e9/input_rate). This is nominal sample-grid bookkeeping, not hardware calibration.

fixed_criteria.count: ceil(N*16000/rate) at all 9 declared rates and 18 boundary lengths; no endpoint-silence trimming is silently equated to the raw-resampler count criterion.
fixed_criteria.partition: All output sample bits compared for 1024, one-sample and 1/7/257/1024 partition patterns.
fixed_criteria.identity: All finite 16k sample bits include first/last, signed zeros and extreme f32 values.
fixed_criteria.alias: RMS ratio<=0.01 relative to the declared input tone RMS for all predeclared below-Nyquist alias fixtures, i.e.>=40dB.
fixed_criteria.images: Folded Fs-frequency first-image amplitude/fundamental<=0.01 for 8000/11025Hz inputs and 1000/3000Hz tones, as predeclared. No full-band/image sweep is inferred.
fixed_criteria.support_trim: Fixed edge removals 64/47/0/33/32 output samples follow the declared filter support, without adaptive masking/retuning.
fixed_criteria.state_and_finish: History/table/count checks plus short EOF, repeated public finish, sequence/rate/time/empty gaps, continuous 12s cut, silence clock and invalid-input preservation are present.

design_math_only.interpretation: Retained proposal/design evidence only; this review did not rerun it and it does not substitute for Rust/filter execution.

limits_and_unrun: No Cargo, compiler, unit/DSP tests, app/GUI/audio/capture, network or model execution. No sealed evaluation inputs/gold were inspected.
Actual f32 Rust spectral results and bit/partition/count behavior require the unchanged guarded tests. Compilation is not established by source review.
No sustained CPU/allocation/latency/RSS measurement, hardware timing/drift/calibration, device/route/sleep-resume, ASR accuracy or reference acceptance.

The endpoint intentionally suppresses leading/subthreshold batches and keeps its existing RMS and packet-granular segmentation behavior; raw resampler count/partition acceptance does not claim sample-preserving VAD output.
No entire audio subsystem/security audit or unrelated queue offset/capture implementation change was attempted.
